title: Expose cross-owner as-of temporal coherence in existing Director context
objective: Implement the smallest deterministic read-only temporal-coherence block in the existing owner-bound Director context using already available timestamps and existing owner tolerances, exposing age spread and contract violations without inventing new freshness thresholds, interpolation or market semantics.

evidence.summary: Existing context freezes capture/predecessor timing and a 48h predecessor degradation rule.
Existing multi-horizon context preserves anchor timestamps, actual spans and tolerances, while external owner families carry independent timestamps.
Program finding requires compact cross-owner as-of coherence using only existing timing contracts.

reproduction: On fresh main, build or inspect the current Director context and confirm individual timing fields exist but no single cross-owner block reports decision cutoff, owner ages/age spread, nominal-vs-actual horizon spans and violations of already-existing owner tolerances.

positive: Fixture with valid timestamps exposes exact ages/spread and WITHIN_EXISTING_CONTRACTS when no existing tolerance is violated.
Fixture violating an already-defined owner/horizon tolerance reports EXISTING_CONTRACT_VIOLATION with the exact offending family/horizon.
negative: Unknown timestamps remain UNKNOWN and are not assumed stale.
No new freshness threshold is invented and no evidence is interpolated, forward-filled, dropped or re-timestamped to force alignment.
